steps.decide: Which criteria actually narrow the operator's decision, and which are merely available in the schema
Where the criteria live (URL, never component state) so sharing, refresh and the card reflow keep them
How typing becomes a request: debounce window, cancellation, and which response wins
How the result count and active criteria are announced without stealing focus
How long identifiers, translated labels and zero-result states render without clipping or lying

rules.statement: A filter earns its place by changing the result set in a way the operator decides on; a facet that every record shares is removed from the toolbar, not disabled.
Query, filters and sort are serialised into the URL so a shared link, a refresh and a back-navigation all restore the same view.
When the results reflow from table to cards at 640 px, the active criteria, the page and the focused control survive the change; nothing is reset because the layout changed.
Typing debounces for 250 ms and cancels the in-flight request; a response that arrives after a newer query is discarded, never rendered over it.
Every settled result set announces its count and active criteria through a polite live region, while focus stays in the search field or the toolbar.
Identifiers longer than 24 characters truncate in the middle with the full value exposed as the accessible name, because the discriminating part of an id is usually its tail.
No records exist and no records match are separate states with separate actions: create one, or clear the filters.
A failed query keeps the previous results visible and the criteria editable, with the error announced; it never replaces the operator's view with an error page.

stateMachine.staleResponseRule: latest query wins; responses for superseded queries are discarded by sequence number, and a response whose query no longer matches the field is never rendered

transitions.trigger: the search field or a chip receives focus

motion.motion: focus ring appears with no delay
motion.reducedMotion: identical — the ring is immediate in both cases

transitions.trigger: the debounce window elapses and a query is sent

motion.motion: results dim to 60% over 120ms and a progress bar appears in the toolbar
motion.reducedMotion: results freeze without dimming; the progress bar's text status carries the state
results swap instantly and the live region announces the count

transitions.trigger: the request fails or times out

motion.motion: error banner slides down 160ms above the preserved results
motion.reducedMotion: banner appears instantly above the preserved results

motion.motion: chip settles over 120ms while results dim
motion.reducedMotion: chip state swaps instantly; results freeze without dimming

motion.motion: chips fade out over 120ms and the full set returns
motion.reducedMotion: chips disappear instantly and the full set returns

transitions.trigger: the surface is read-only for this role

motion.noneReason: a permission boundary is not an animation; controls simply stop being operable and say why
returning permission restores operability; a control does not animate its own permissions

transitions.trigger: a chip's pending toggle is applied

motion.motion: the chip settles over 120ms while results dim
motion.reducedMotion: the chip state swaps instantly and results freeze without dimming

refused.reason: an inline toolbar has no pressed state of its own; chips carry it
the inline variant only renders when the role may search

sections.intent: Let an operator narrow a long record set to the few rows that decide their next action, and let the narrowing survive a refresh, a shared link and a layout change.
useCases: find one record by a fragment of its title
narrow to a status and a date window
hand a colleague a link that opens the same filtered view
nicheDifferences: Operate surfaces are used repeatedly by the same person, so the state of the criteria is worth more than the novelty of the control: the toolbar must be boring, fast and remember.
inputs: the record schema and which fields are genuinely discriminating
whether results arrive server-side or are filtered client-side
the longest realistic value per column, including ids
the roles that may search and the ones that may not
anatomy: search field with a visible label and a clear action
results region that keeps its scroll position
error banner above the preserved results
styling: the toolbar is one row of 44 px controls; chips wrap to a second row rather than shrinking
active chips are distinguished by border weight as well as colour
the progress bar is 2 px and lives in the toolbar, never over the results
a11y: chips are real buttons with aria-pressed, and each has an accessible name that names its facet
the result count is announced in a polite live region, never as a focus move
Escape clears the field, and the field is reachable with a single shortcut from the page
long identifiers keep the full value in the accessible name when truncated visually
responsive: below 640 px the toolbar collapses into a 'Filters (3)' button that opens a sheet, while the criteria stay in the URL
the sheet is a dialog with focus trapped and Escape to close
the results region reflows from table to cards without losing scroll position or criteria
copy: the empty states name the action: 'No records yet — create the first one' and 'No records match these filters — clear them'
the error names the failure and the recovery, never 'Something went wrong'
counts read as '24 records' / '1 record', not '24 results found!'
alternatives: a query builder for analysts who need boolean nesting
saved views when the same filter set is reopened weekly
facets with counts when the schema has many shared values

references.label: WAI-ARIA APG — combobox and live regions
SUS issue #10 — filter/sort/search continuity across layout changes

acceptance: typing 250 ms produces exactly one request and the latest response wins
the URL contains the criteria and reloading restores them
reflowing to cards at 640 px keeps the criteria, page and focus
a 40 % longer translated label does not clip or push controls out of the row
a failed query leaves the previous results on screen and announces the error
failureCases: a stale response overwrites newer results because the sequence number was not checked
the toolbar resets when the layout changes from table to cards
an id truncated at the end hides the only discriminating characters
an empty state offers no action and the operator is stuck
